# Briefing preferences

<!-- observed: 2026-07-14 | status: active -->
- **Daily brief:** wants a short, **focus-time-protecting** brief first thing — surface **only what
  needs me today** (PRs blocking teammates, on-call, decisions owed, commitments due), and
  explicitly call out my **protected morning block** so meetings don't creep in.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-14 | status: active -->
- Keep it scannable: a few bullets, most-important first. No filler.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-14 | status: active -->
- **Weekly preview (Mondays):** the week's key decisions to land, prep owed, and commitments coming due.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-14 | status: active -->
- **Weekly retro (Fridays):** what shipped, what slipped, on-call/incident load for the week.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-14 | status: active -->
- Always flag **overdue commitments** at the top of any brief.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-14 | status: active -->
- Refer to confidential items (Aurora) by code name in every brief.
